title: OpenPike model prices
description: Prices in USD per 1 million tokens, keyed by provider/model. Only prices read from the provider's own pricing page.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

$comment.description: Notes for people editing the file.

propertyNames.description: <provider slug>/<model id>, exactly as a request names the model.

cached_input.description: Input tokens read from the provider's prompt cache. Defaults to input.

cache_write.description: Input tokens written to the cache (5-minute cache). Defaults to input.

cache_write_1h.description: Input tokens written to the 1-hour cache, when the response reports them separately. Defaults to cache_write.

tier.description: Rates that apply instead of the base rates when the whole prompt (cache reads and writes included) is above above_prompt_tokens. The highest matching tier wins.

tiers.description: Prompt-length tiers, each with a different above_prompt_tokens.

change.description: A price change the provider has announced. Its rates (and tiers, when given) replace the base ones from 00:00 UTC on the from day.

from.description: First day (UTC) the new rates apply.

tiers.description: Replaces the base tiers from that day. An empty list removes them; leave it out to keep them.

changes.description: Announced price changes, oldest first, each with a later from date.

as_of.description: The day the price was read from source.

note.description: Free text, for example how a discount or region is handled.
